It is important to note that different biomarkers have different characteristics — for example, AST was the first cardiac biomarker used in 1954 but is no longer widely used due to non-specificity, while LDH is also not recommended for MI diagnosis due to poor specificity — and that multiple biomarkers are often measured over several hours to ensure accurate detection and estimation of severity
